title: certihom: certified amortized homogenization
description: Guaranteed two-sided Löwner bounds on effective conductivity and elasticity tensors, computed from neural trial fields whose admissibility is enforced architecturally. A single trained operator certifies microstructures it has never seen at inference cost. Includes exact-integration certification (Q1 and Bogner-Fox-Schmit C1 elements), a bandwidth-versus-Nyquist criterion for collocation adequacy, three independent reference solvers (finite volume, conforming Q1 FEM, Moulinec-Suquet FFT), a verification suite of 26 tests with machine-precision anchors against closed-form solutions, and seeded scripts that regenerate every number and figure in the accompanying manuscript.
